theorems.name: Submission.rsod_c1tan_chart_separation
theorems.statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn m)) (W : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (φ : Rn m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (v₀ : Rn m), IsOpen W → ContinuousOn φ V → InjOn φ V → v₀ ∈ V → φ v₀ ∈ W → (∀ K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → IsCompact (V ∩ φ ⁻¹' K)) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ v ∈ V, δ ≤ ‖v - v₀‖ → ε ≤ ‖φ v - φ v₀‖
